The Chinese characters for Silas

As a transliteration, Silas is usually written 赛拉斯 (Sài lā sī). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

赛
Sài
contest, match
拉
lā

斯
sī

Origin and meaning

With Latin origins, Silas is usually read as “of the forest”.

About the name Silas

In the New Testament, Silas travelled with Saint Paul.

As a gift or a tattoo

Because it means “of the forest”, a Silas calligraphy print makes a thoughtful gift for someone who loves the name or its meaning.
